technical_and_design_decisions: Extract SPI implementations from the monolithic admin project into individual Git repositories (spring-cloud-deployer-lattice, spring-cloud-deployer-kubernetes, spring-cloud-deployer-mesos).
Update the shared DeploymentState enum in the core deployer SPI contract to introduce the explicit 'UNDEPLOYED' state.
Refactor deployer status Resolution logic across all SPIs (CF, Lattice, K8s, Mesos, Local) so that streams/apps lacking deployment context return 'UNDEPLOYED' instead of 'UNKNOWN'.
Standardize Maven/Gradle build configurations and GitHub Actions / Concourse CI pipelines across the new SPI repositories.
assumptions: Developer has administrative permissions to create new Git repositories and configure CI/CD pipelines.
Mesos SPI codebase exists locally or in a branch and needs extraction, formatting, and submission as a standalone PR.
Core SPI contract changes will be published first or referenced via snapshot build during the implementation of deployer-specific updates.
Automated unit and integration test suites are available for each deployer SPI and can be run locally or via CI.

activities.activity_name: Create and configure separate repository for Lattice SPI (U2)

activities.activity_description: Extract Kubernetes SPI code into a dedicated repository, configure Maven/Gradle builds, CI pipelines, and repository documentation.

activities.activity_description: Extract Mesos SPI code into its own standalone repository and configure build automation and project structure.

activities.activity_name: Prepare and submit PR for Mesos SPI (U1)
activities.activity_description: Perform code cleanup, ensure test coverage, write PR description, and submit the Pull Request for existing Mesos SPI work.

activities.activity_name: Core SPI UNDEPLOYED status model and strategy updates (U7)
activities.activity_description: Add UNDEPLOYED enum value to DeploymentState in the core deployer contract and update common status determination logic for streams without deployment context.

activities.activity_name: Implement UNDEPLOYED status for Cloud Foundry SPI (U5)
activities.activity_description: Update Cloud Foundry AppDeployer implementation to return UNDEPLOYED status when app deployment context is missing, updating corresponding unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement UNDEPLOYED status for Lattice SPI (U6)
activities.activity_description: Update Lattice AppDeployer implementation and unit tests to handle UNDEPLOYED state appropriately.

activities.activity_name: Implement UNDEPLOYED status for Kubernetes SPI (U8)
activities.activity_description: Update Kubernetes AppDeployer implementation and unit tests to return UNDEPLOYED when resource or deployment context is absent.
Execute integration tests across all SPI implementations to verify consistent behavior for undeployed streams and ensure backwards compatibility.
